files.reason: Include existing xpm.h owning the char**get_xpm return contract before sprite creation. Destroy expired shots' Sprites and maps, and decode the HP/time-bar XPMs once per frame instead of once per drawn segment.
files.verification: Original actual game.c compilation fails incompatible int-to-pointer conversions at fourteen XPM calls. Corrected actual owning-unit regression passes strict pointer conversion and optimized compilation.

files.reason: Send Set Stream Mode0xEA to PS2 data port0x60 and consume/validate command ACKs before packet decoding. Interpret positive motion low bytes as unsigned for the full9-bit PS2 range.
files.verification: Original real touch+460,+480 missed Start because unread0xFA was consumed as a packet header. Original command fixture fails data-port contract; corrected0xEA/F4 ACK fixtures verify0xFA success and0xFE/FC failure. Original signed-char packet fixture fails positive128 motion; corrected independently checks X/Y deltas−255,−128,−1,0,1,127,128,255. Actual normal gesture now starts the arena; portrait/landscape movement and heart-decreasing shot proof recorded separately.

controlsRationale: Original1024x768 indexed two-human platform duel. Menu cursor50,50 and Start rectangle354..673,500..560. Crosshair resets300,700 when a turn starts. Blue player uses A/D and W/Space; red player uses J/L/I. Left WASD stick plus Jump and P2 movement/jump buttons preserve both players, right relative mouse stick aims, Shoot/Select clicks. Panel keeps action/pad controls outside the field. Relative touch only, no calibrated direct cursor profile. Existing scene rules, original sprites/platforms/timer and player role swaps remain unchanged.

artwork.icon: Original blue/red trooper numeric-palette XPMs enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels on a simple dark tile. Original arrays unchanged.
artwork.preview: Actual first shooter hit reduces one original heart, scaled to640x480.

verification.browser: Actual CDP touch in844x390 and390x844 selects Start, moves both original troopers, jumps onto the platform and aims/fires. First successful shot reduces original heart pixels3470 to2776, exactly one694-pixel heart, in each orientation. Escape exits normally with no page errors. Shared SDK corner-action hit testing supplies joystick touch alongside action buttons.
verification.ndk: All10 authored C units and generated context compiled as actual ARM64 objects with O2, FORTIFY2, stack protector and format-security.

native.demonstrated: Original blue and red troopers use independent touch controls. Timed ordinary Jump then left lands blue beside red. Screenshot-guided shot reduces original five red hearts to four (3445→2756 sampled red pixels). Clean Home return.
